summaries.zh: Multi-account OpenCode Go quota meter for DeepSeek Harness. It auto-detects every OpenCode Go provider in `llm-pi-ai.providers` (no account count in plugin code), reads the 5-hour / weekly / monthly windows from the official usage endpoint, and follows the session provider so switching models swaps the reading immediately.
